output.revised_prompt:
Create an original high-end photorealistic 3D production portrait backdrop for a mobile slot game in Cocos Creator. Portrait 2:3. Exact front orthographic view, perfectly centered and symmetrical. A single freestanding real casino jackpot slot-machine tower on a softly blurred luxury gaming floor, with no other cabinet competing for attention. The tall tapered machine fills approximately 97% of image height and 93% of width.

Design a distinctly angular, faceted showpiece silhouette—clearly unlike conventional rounded slot cabinets. Top: a cut-diamond crown with tiered completely blank jackpot windows, champagne-gold structural ribs, ivory enamel, clear faceted crystal, muted emerald glass side blades, pearl light rails, coin-reservoir details, and only tiny restrained ruby accents. Near the top, include a wide EMPTY dark-burgundy diamond-cut marquee with no markings. Below it, a small EMPTY ivory balance capsule.

Upper-middle: one large EMPTY bright-ivory five-reel aperture, clean and unobstructed for live reels, visibly divided/composed for five columns but containing no symbols, text, letters, numbers, or imagery. Frame the aperture in faceted clear crystal and refined champagne gold. Below: one narrow completely blank win plaque.

Console: an angular physical control deck with two recessed bet wells on the left, one large central spin-button recess, and one smaller auto-button recess on the right; all surfaces and buttons blank with no icons or labels. Lower pedestal: tall and elegant, with a luminous diamond-and-pearl medallion and several small round unlabelled hold-and-spin lamp sockets. Keep all live UI zones uncluttered and readable.

Materials and rendering: believable premium casino construction—cut crystal, optical glass, champagne-gold metal, pearl ivory enamel, burgundy lacquer, emerald glass, soft marquee bulbs. Warm gold marquee illumination, soft emerald edge glow, controlled diamond caustics, celebratory jackpot excitement without harsh darkness. Premium yet soft commercial product lighting, crisp cabinet detail, gentle depth of field only in the background. Palette: champagne gold, pearl ivory, deep burgundy, clear diamond white, muted emerald, tiny ruby details.

Strict exclusions: absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no currency symbols, no watermark, no characters, no reel symbols, no branding. Original design only. Avoid rounded cabinet forms, spaceship aesthetics, sci-fi cockpit, neon cyberpunk, royal-palace styling, black-dominant machine, cheap yellow plastic, flat illustration, and clutter over live UI zones.
